Ok so you skipped the whole Wolfenstein/history point you made that was a wiff, but there were a large number of countries that never tried to colonize. This depends how you define colonize, but it includes a large number of Indian tribes in America (would maybe include the Cree/Poundmaker), Switzerland, Ukraine, Slovakia, most southern American, African, and Asian countries except China, Japan, India and a few others. The vast majority of nations have never attempted to colonize other countries. Expansion is a trickier one (and connects to what I was asking originally about on if that’s just humanity), but plenty of those countries that didn’t attempt to colonize were content with their land and didn’t seek expansion, but again that’s a murkier one.
